news.title: Erling Haaland sues Norwegian Air over World Cup ad featuring his ponytail
news.lede: Norway football star Erling Haaland has taken legal action against Norwegian Air Shuttle, alleging that the airline used elements of his appearance without permission in a World Cup advertisement. The dispute centres on a social media post released during the 2026 FIFA World Cup, when Norway made its first appearance at the tournament since 1998. According to Norwegian newspaper Verdens Gang (VG), the airline shared a composite image of one of its aircraft featuring a ponytail resembling Haaland's distinctive hairstyle. The post carried the caption, "We've never looked more Norwegian," referencing the national team's World Cup campaign.

news.title: Nigeria's Special Eagles prep for 2026 Amputee World Cup

The Major tournament will take place in San Juan De Los Lagos, Mexico, running from November 13 to 22.

news.title: FIFA Identifies Key Trends From 2026 World Cup
news.lede: FIFA has published its post-tournament technical report on the 2026 World Cup, highlighting counter-pressing, tactical flexibility and the evolving role of goalkeepers as some of the major trends that shaped the tournament. The report, compiled by FIFA’s Technical Study Group (TSG) and Football Performance Insights Department, analysed all 104 matches…... The report, compiled by FIFA’s Technical Study Group (TSG) and Football Performance Insights Department, analysed all 104 matches using expert assessment, football data and video analysis. According to FIFA, counter-pressing emerged as one of the defining features of the tournament, with top teams frequently turning the loss of possession into immediate attacking opportunities.

news.title: Coaching, climate, continuity - and Cruyff: How Spain conquered international football
news.lede: Spain became the first international team to go 40 matches unbeaten on Tuesday with a 4-1 Uefa Nations League win against Croatia in Seville. That followed a weekend when the European and world champions defeated an England side ranked fourth in the world, 3-2 at Wembley . Spain’s Under-20 women's team were crowned world champions with a triumph against North Korea on Sunday. Most of those players were already Under-17 world champions in 2024, retaining the title they had won in 2022.

news.title: High ticket prices threaten turnout for historic India-Brazil Kolkata friendly
news.lede: Kolkata: Brazil coming to Kolkata was always supposed to be a date with destiny for a football-mad city that has loved the Selecao from afar for generations. From Pele, whose 1977 visit remains part of the city’s football folklore, to the World Cup-winning sides featuring mega stars like Ronaldo, Rivaldo and Ronaldinho, Brazil have inspired a devotion here matched only by arch-rivals Argentina. So when the five-time world champions finally arrived to play India at the Salt Lake Stadium, a packed house appeared almost a given. Even Marquinhos seemed overwhelmed by the reception on Friday with close to 200 journalists packing the pre-match press conference and then the pre-match training sessions.

news.title: FIFA Reportedly to Decide 2030 World Cup Final Venue in 2028
news.lede: Casablanca – FIFA is reportedly expected to announce its decision on the 2030 World Cup final venue in 2028, leaving Morocco’s bid to stage the showpiece match at the Hassan II Stadium firmly alive. According to Spanish outlet Mundo Deportivo, sources familiar with the process say FIFA does not plan to reveal the final venue before 2028. The report points to the previous World Cup cycle, when FIFA waited until February 2024 to confirm New Jersey as the venue for the 2026 final. The timeline means the competition between Morocco and Spain remains open despite increasingly confident statements from both sides.
